categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in three main business segments: (1) New semiconductor display intelligent equipment - including binding equipment, lamination equipment, AOI detection equipment, and large/ultra-large size TV integrated equipment for TFT-LCD, OLED, Mini LED, and Micro LED display modules; (2) Automotive intelligent cockpit system equipment - providing assembly equipment for automotive smart cabin displays; (3) Semiconductor packaging and testing equipment - including flip-chip equipment, die bonding equipment, and AOI detection equipment; (4) New energy equipment - including lithium battery module cutting, stacking, and assembly line automation equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies include: high-vacuum curved surface lamination technology, material mechanics simulation technology, machine vision underlying/multi-axis control development technology, laser cutting/welding technology, high-speed/high-precision die bonding process technology, flexible assembly technology, pulse/constant temperature hot pressing technology, and high-precision machining technology. Production methods employ flexible manufacturing with small-batch, multi-batch production based on customer orders, combining self-manufacturing of core components with outsourced processing of non-core parts.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include leading semiconductor display manufacturers (BOE, Visionox, Tianma, Huaxing Optoelectronics), automotive electronics suppliers (Continental, Bosch, Visteon, Harman, Delphi), and consumer electronics brands (Apple, Foxconn, Huawei, BYD). End markets include smartphones, tablets, laptops, automotive displays, VR/AR/MR devices, and new energy vehicles.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with major presence in East China (Jiangsu, Shanghai), West China (Sichuan, Chongqing), Central China (Hubei), North China, and South China regions. International operations include subsidiaries in Romania (LIANDE EQUIPMENT S.R.L) serving European markets, with products exported to Europe, Southeast Asia, and North America.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the supply chain. It manufactures specialized equipment used by semiconductor display panel manufacturers and automotive electronics suppliers in their production processes, positioning it as a B2B equipment supplier rather than an end-product manufacturer.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) advancing AMOLED and Mini/Micro LED display equipment technology; (2) expanding into automotive intelligent cockpit systems; (3) developing semiconductor packaging and testing equipment; (4) entering new energy battery equipment markets; (5) pursuing international market expansion; (6) enhancing R&D capabilities in high-precision point-gluing, UTG lamination, silicon-based binding, and mass transfer technologies.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of customized equipment to manufacturers. Revenue is recognized when customers take control of equipment after installation, debugging, and acceptance. The company also generates revenue from equipment-related services and spare parts. In 2024, equipment sales represented 97.46% of total revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In display equipment, the company competes with Japanese and Korean manufacturers in front-end processes but holds a leading domestic position in module assembly equipment. Key competitors include international equipment manufacturers. The company positions itself as a leading Chinese supplier with advantages in cost-effectiveness, service proximity, and customization capabilities. In semiconductor and new energy equipment, the company is establishing competitive positions through technological innovation and market expansion.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized equipment manufacturer with 2024 revenue of 1.396 billion yuan (15.63% YoY growth) and net profit of 243 million yuan (37.06% YoY growth). Total assets reached 2.786 billion yuan. The company demonstrates strong growth trajectory with expanding market share, particularly in emerging display technologies and new energy sectors. Gross margin improved to 37.18% in 2024.
